title: Time-pressure launch profile — scripted teammates, typed chat only, 5-minute task with teammate time remarks (approved, live-eligible)
notes: tp_scripted_v11 succeeds tp_scripted_v10 under owner direction 2026-10-12 (ask-routing fixes after live-log review of the v8 fielding): (1) timing.scripted_requests.targets becomes ['unassigned','assigned_own','unassigned'] — the active-130 s ask now targets one of the participant's own-file assigned crates and the planner guarantees the asking seat holds no records on it, ending the pattern where a teammate asked about a team-dependent crate it already held the truth for; (2) instruments.training binds training.reference@v5 — the typed practice ask joins the practice share as a completion gate (practice_ask_required), teaching the ask mechanic before the task. Also in this build (code, not artifacts): multi-crate typed asks fan out to one card per named crate (cap 4), a broadcast ask delivers the single newest record across both seats' holdings, intel-flavoured text naming no crate gets the 'name the crate' invite, and the answer bar shows a neutral 'New entry on Crate N added to your file' cue when teammate intel lands. The deterministic_only teammate keeps its pinned line pools (teammates.social_prompt stays unbound). consent.reference@v8, payment.s5_base_only@v5, debrief.tp_reference@v3 unchanged. Preview/QA first per owner — no new fielding group. Nothing else changes.

tp_scripted_v10 succeeds tp_scripted_v9 under owner direction 2026-10-10 (comprehension check + revised incentive phrasing): binds consent.reference@v8 ('eligible to receive a bonus of up to $0.50 based on your performance on the task') and training.reference@v4 (five-item true/false comprehension gate before 'Connecting you to your team', server-held answer key, recorded attempts). payment.s5_base_only@v5 and debrief.tp_reference@v3 unchanged. Preview/QA first per owner — no new fielding group until lab testing passes. Nothing else changes.

tp_scripted_v9 succeeds tp_scripted_v8 under owner direction 2026-10-10 (incentive compatibility): binds consent.reference@v7 ('$3.00 plus a $0.50 bonus for correctly locating your assigned crates'), payment.s5_base_only@v5 (350 cents flat to every completer — the offered bonus is paid to all, non-deception per owner/university IRB), training.reference@v3 (Case background bonus sentence) and debrief.tp_reference@v3 ('the accuracy bonus is paid to every completer'). Pilot incentive frame, not a pre-registered condition — applies identically to all cells. Field through successor group study.live.v8; old pins remain immutable. Nothing else changes: timing, remarks, requests, teammate treatment, assistant pins identical.
Proposal under D01: 60 active s of own-file review and answer drafting with teammate and AI channels closed, then the check-in (outside active time), then 300 active s with all channels (spec §4.1).
Scripted requests at interaction seconds 20/120/210 = active 80/180/270 remain a proposal until D01; they are not values from S4.
All response classes use the concurrent mechanism (spec §6.5); distributions reuse the reference parameters pending D10.
Request seats: majority seat drawn by a fair coin (not always JT) so request sender stays balanced against the rating seat (spec §7.1 invariant 7); proposal under D07.
Re-issued as tp_review_first_v4 to bind consent.reference@v3 (Appendix B verbatim: '#XXXX-XXXX' transcription fix, BA-37); content otherwise identical to tp_review_first_v3.

UX round 3 item 5 (revised 2026-10-07, BA-97): the own time-pressure rating is skippable — consent states skipping questions does not affect payment; the server accepts pressure_skip. An unanswered check-in still times out to technical_stop, which keeps base pay under D04.
FR-1 feature flag: structured requests plus natural language (the pre-round-3 behavior).

Approved for live fielding (2026-10-06, D04 revised 2026-10-07): D01 (field tp_review_first), D02 (pressure values high [6,7] / low [2,3]), D04 ($4.00 base; completed + technical_stop paid, early leave forfeits), D06 (instrument copy), D07 (generated teammate/assistant contributions with validated fallback), D10 (timing) resolved per PI direction; main-campus IRB confirmed blanket protocol coverage, no amendment required.

2026-10-06: v8 was published pointing at consent.reference@v3 (still proposed_unapproved) and could never bind live; nothing enrolled on it. v9 retargets consent to the approved v4 — v8 remains immutable published history.
UX round 3 (2026-10-03, plan §17): binds fallbacks.neutral@v2 (warm pleasantries, no repeated lines; still pressure-neutral).
Re-issued to bind fallback_bank v3 (O-1/O-3 2026-10-03): adds the asks_intel_nl typed-ask pool for nl_only and the fixed identity_probe disclosure lines. No other field changes.

UX round 4 (UX_Feedback_v4, 2026-10-05): re-issued to bind requests.demo@v2 (varied scripted-request phrasing), fallbacks.neutral@v4 (diversified social-reply pool), and post_task.tp_demo@v2 (pre-debrief teammate-nature choice item).

v10 (2026-10-07, BA-96/97/98/99 audit remediation): fields the approved generated-contribution treatment — social_generation model_with_validated_fallback with prompt.social_demo@v3 as bound persona wording; assistant pins local_openai_chat + gemma4:26b digest + grounded_prompts_v5 + teammate_output_v7.

Compensation is the consent-v4 rule: completed and technical_stop keep the $4.00 base; abandoned/withdrawn/declined forfeit it (outcomes.withdrawal_payment=forfeits_base). The check-in pressure rating is skippable, matching consent 'skipping questions does not affect payment'.
All bound artifacts are approved successors (BA-99); preview/QA profiles may still bind the reference versions. Decisions D01/D02/D04/D06/D07/D10 resolved as recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md.

v11 (2026-10-07, owner direction): drops the 60 s solo_review phase — the approved protocol and office-hours scope cover timing revisions within the task, and the phase added an undocumented pre-task downtime with no participant deliverable (lab sessions show zero solo-window activity). All channels open from task start; check-in stays at active 60 s; every other binding identical to v10.

2026-10-08 (owner direction): four-condition launch — teammate mechanism (AI vs scripted) x pressure (high vs low), assigned by one platform link with balanced 4-cell blocks across tp_ai_v1 and tp_scripted_v2 (batch group; allocation at consent). Binds every approved v11 artifact verbatim; the per-manifest allocation_policy below describes the arm pair within this manifest only.

tp_scripted_v3 = tp_scripted_v2 with interaction.mode nl_only and structured_seeking removed — typed chat only, same surface as tp_ai_v1. After this the ONLY differences across the four cells are pressure (high/low) and teammate mechanism (model_with_validated_fallback vs deterministic_only); typed intel asks resolve via the approved asks_intel_nl pool in both builds. Supersedes tp_scripted_v2, which kept the v11 ask picker (an interaction-surface confound on the teammate contrast).

tp_scripted_v4 = tp_scripted_v3 + all measurement items required (owner direction 2026-10-08): binds consent.reference@v5 (skip promise removed), confidence.demo@v3 and post_task.tp_demo@v4 (skippable=false on every item), and own_rating_skippable=false (server rejects pressure_skip). Otherwise identical to tp_scripted_v3 — nl_only + deterministic_only.

tp_scripted_v5 succeeds tp_scripted_v4 under owner direction 2026-10-08 (risk assessment G6): requests.demo@v4 draws the three approved request phrasings without replacement in one session-wide keyed permutation. Timing, targets, sender draws, required instruments and teammate treatment are unchanged. Field through successor group study.live.v4; old pins remain immutable.

tp_scripted_v6 succeeds tp_scripted_v5 under owner direction 2026-10-09 (first N=5 pilot debrief): active task budget 360 -> 300 s; check-in unchanged at active 60; scripted requests at active 45 (pre-check-in) / 130 / 210 (was 80/180/270), same targets and seat policy; one-minute warning v3 at active 240; consent.reference@v6 (~12 minutes, $3.00) with payment.s5_base_only@v4 (300 cents); adds manipulation.remarks = remarks.tp_pressure@v1 — two fixed arm-specific teammate chat lines at active 75 and 83, speaker order a per-session fair coin. Teammate treatment unchanged: deterministic_only; the remarks are identical bound copy in both teammate builds. Field through successor group study.live.v5; old pins remain immutable.

tp_scripted_v7 succeeds tp_scripted_v6 under the RCA-2026-10-09 remediation: repins prompt.assistant_demo@v2 -> v3 — the narrowed assistant contract (asked crate only, newest entries first, at most three most recent entries, ENTRY crate= attribute resolves the crate when bodies name only contents). Pairs with code-side grounded_prompts_v6 and assistant_output_claims_v3 (transit-destination / anchored-retelling / not-moved / per-occurrence fixes). Fielded through successor group study.live.v6 after assistant acceptance QA; old pins remain immutable. Nothing else changes: timing, remarks, requests, consent, instruments, teammate treatment identical.

tp_scripted_v8 succeeds tp_scripted_v7 under the assistant-generation-rejections audit remediation (2026-10-10): repins prompt.assistant_demo@v3 -> v4 — v3's 'start with the most recent location' instruction made the model prepend a location label that violates the grounded_prompts_v7 verbatim-excerpt grammar (every generated release-panel probe rejected unvalidated_response despite accurate content; 12/12 replayed v3 trials reproduce it). v4 instructs excerpt-only replies and passes 12/12 replayed probes as record_excerpts with zero violations. Fielded through successor group study.live.v7 after the assistant release panel; old pins remain immutable. Nothing else changes: timing, remarks, requests, consent, instruments, teammate treatment identical.
